help.dropText: The slab slides side to side. Tap the playfield, click, press Space, Enter, or gamepad A to drop it.
help.trimText: Any overhang is shaved off — the tower keeps only the overlap, and the next slab travels the other axis.
help.perfectText: Drop dead centre (within the glowing margin) to keep full width, earn bonus points, and grow a streak.
help.assistsText: Where allowed, press H to mark the perfect window and U to take back a drop. Ranked modes disable both.
help.limitsText: Some stages limit drops or time. Misses spend drops too. The clock only runs while you play.
help.keyboardText: {drop} drop · {pause} pause · {undo} undo · {hint} hint · {camera} camera · {back} back. Full game is keyboard-operable.
board.empty: No scores yet — be the first.
ji.j01: Tap, click, or press Space when the sliding slab is over the tower. Anything hanging over the edge is trimmed away.
ji.j03: Drop dead centre for a perfect placement — perfects keep your full width and build a streak.
ji.j05: Chain perfects for growing streak bonuses.
ji.j08: New: a drop limit. Misses spend drops too — 16 drops for 12 slabs.
ji.j10: MASTERY: a drop limit and the clock together.
ji.j13: You carry a spare slab: one clean miss is forgiven.
ji.j15: New: a time limit. The clock only runs while you play.
ji.j16: A narrower first stone — every trim hurts more.
ji.j20: MASTERY: fast slabs, tight limits, one life.
ji.j30: MASTERY: everything so far, at dawn.
ji.j40: MASTERY: the definitive ascent. One life, thin air, no mercy.
chi.c1: Ten slabs, ten drops. Every placement must land — no misses allowed.
chi.c2: Reach 18 slabs before the clock runs out.
chi.c3: A thread-thin foundation and a razor perfect window. No hints.
chi.c4: 14 perfect-required drops inside one minute. No room to breathe.
chi.c5: Forty slabs with ever-quickening sway. Endurance, not burst.
chi.c6: Drop limit, time limit, hairline window, no assists. The full test.
score.name: Endless Spire
score.intro: The tower rises until a slab sails past. Play for height and precision.
daily.name: Daily {date}
daily.intro: One shared seed for everyone, today only. Ranked — no undo.
lx.t1: A slab slides above the foundation. Tap the playfield, click, or press Space to drop it. Land three slabs to finish the lesson.
lx.t2: Drop when the slab is dead centre for a perfect placement — no trimming, extra points, and a streak. Score two perfects.
lx.t3: Off-center drops are trimmed: the tower keeps only the overlap and the next slab travels the other way. Recover and place four slabs.
lx.t4: Some stages limit your drops or your time. Reach six slabs within ten drops — misses spend drops too.
lx.t5: In relaxed modes you can undo a drop (U) or ask for a hint (H) that marks the perfect window. Place a slab, then undo it.
